nodes.name: .graphify_analysis.json
nodes.summary: Graphify analysis metadata describing detected communities, cohesion, highly connected nodes, surprising relationships, and suggested questions for the Customer-Churn-Prediction project.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON report organized around analysis result collections rather than executable configuration settings.

nodes.name: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Generated graph report summarizing the project's 105 nodes, 218 edges, seven communities, graph freshness, central nodes, connection highlights, isolated nodes, and suggested investigation questions.

nodes.name: graph.html
nodes.summary: Standalone browser visualization for the generated Graphify network, with search, node inspection, community filtering, legend controls, and interactive navigation powered by vis-network.
nodes.languageNotes: HTML embeds CSS and JavaScript, loads vis-network from a pinned CDN asset, and initializes the graph from embedded node and edge data.

nodes.name: graph.json
nodes.summary: Generated Graphify graph dataset containing 105 nodes, 218 directed links, graph metadata, hyperedges, and the commit identifier used to build the visualization input.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON uses a NetworkX-style directed multigraph structure with nodes, links, and hyperedges.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: Generated manifest listing the project artifacts included in the Graphify output, including graph files, Understand Anything metadata, source modules, documentation artifacts, and tests.
